entities.summary: 1958 Revolution and Early Republic, a transformative movement in Iraq (1958–1968). Emerged from Hashemite. Catalyzed Anfal campaign — genocide against Iraqi Kurds using chemical weapons and Iraq invades Kuwait; US-led coalition liberates Kuwait in the Gulf War.
